records.source: Plant these in the spring. Takes 6 days to mature, and has a chance of yielding multiple potatoes at harvest.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa tagsibol. Tumatagal ng 6 na araw upang mahinog at maaaring magbigay ng maraming patatas sa pag-aani.

records.source: Named for the powdery coating that forms on the surface, this melon is crisp and sweet, with a delicate flavor.
records.translation: Ipinangalan sa mala-pulbos na balot na nabubuo sa balat nito, malutong at matamis ang melong ito at banayad ang lasa.
Mga Binhi ng Melong May Pulbos

records.source: This special melon grows in the winter. Takes 7 days to grow.
records.translation: Tumutubo sa taglamig ang natatanging melong ito. Tumatagal ng 7 araw upang lumaki.

records.source: One of the earliest tools employed by humans. This "crude" tool was created by striking one rock with another to form a sharp edge.
records.translation: Isa sa mga pinakaunang kasangkapang ginamit ng tao. Ginawa ang "magaspang" na kasangkapang ito sa paghampas ng isang bato sa isa pa upang lumikha ng matalim na gilid.

records.source: Little gouge marks on the side suggest that this rib was someone's dinner.
records.translation: Ipinahihiwatig ng maliliit na uka sa gilid na naging hapunan ng isang tao ang tadyang na ito.

records.source: Commonly known as a "shoulder blade"... It's unclear what species it belonged to.
records.translation: Karaniwang tinatawag na "buto sa balikat"... Hindi malinaw kung sa anong uri ito nagmula.

records.source: This is definitely a mammalian skull.
records.translation: Tiyak na bungo ito ng isang mamalya.

records.source: A thick and sturdy leg bone.
records.translation: Makapal at matibay na buto ng binti.

records.source: Some kind of gnarly old digging tool.
records.translation: Isang uri ng magaspang at lumang kasangkapang panghukay.

records.source: A segment of some prehistoric creature's spine.
records.translation: Bahagi ng gulugod ng isang sinaunang nilalang.

records.source: Place on a sprinkler to increase its watering range.
records.translation: Ikabit sa Awtomatikong Pandilig upang palawakin ang abot ng pagdidilig nito.

records.source: Harvested from the rare and elusive prismatic slime.
records.translation: Nakukuha mula sa bihira at mailap na Prismatikong Slime.
records.englishResidueReason: Slime is the canonical Filipino glossary's retained creature name.

records.source: A very rare and powerful substance with unknown origins.
records.translation: Napakabihira at makapangyarihang sangkap na hindi alam ang pinagmulan.

records.source: Bring this to the prize machine in Lewis' house for a special reward.
records.translation: Dalhin ito sa makina ng premyo sa bahay ni Lewis upang makakuha ng natatanging gantimpala.

records.source: Stay invincible for a little while longer after taking damage.
records.translation: Manatiling hindi tinatablan nang kaunti pang mas matagal matapos masaktan.

records.source: A fall favorite, grown for its crunchy seeds and delicately flavored flesh. As a bonus, the hollow shell can be carved into a festive decoration.
records.translation: Paborito sa taglagas na itinatanim para sa malulutong na binhi at lamang banayad ang lasa. Bilang dagdag, maaaring ukitan ang hungkag na balat upang gawing dekorasyon sa pagdiriwang.

records.source: Silky pumpkin cream in a flaky crust.
records.translation: Makinis na krema ng kalabasa sa malutong at patong-patong na balat.

records.source: Plant these in the fall. Takes 13 days to mature.
records.translation: Itanim ang mga ito sa taglagas. Tumatagal ng 13 araw upang mahinog.
